{{Top|leg}}
The '''Antipodes''' was a region of [[Coruscant/Legends|Coruscant]] located on the exact opposite side of the [[Planet/Legends|planet]] from [[Galactic City/Legends|Imperial Center]]. It contained the [[Factory District]], which was located in the northeastern quadrisphere near the equator.

==Appearances==
*''[[Coruscant Nights I: Jedi Twilight]]''
